summaries.title: Plan overview
summaries.summary: This 2026 EPO plan from Moda Health has a $8,700 deductible. Specialist visits do not require a referral. Virtual urgent care through CirrusMD is $0.

summaries.title: Deductible and out-of-pocket limit
summaries.summary: In-network deductible is $8,700 individual / $17,400 family. Out-of-pocket limit equals the deductible. Family deductible is embedded, meaning each member has their own deductible.

summaries.title: Doctor visits
summaries.summary: Primary care visits cost $85 copay; specialist visits cost $120 copay. Preventive care is free. All in-network only; deductible does not apply.

summaries.title: Tests
summaries.summary: Diagnostic tests and imaging are covered in-network at 0% coinsurance after the deductible is met. Out-of-network services are not covered. Preauthorization may be required for some tests.

summaries.title: Prescription drugs
summaries.summary: Prescription drug costs depend on the drug tier. Copays or coinsurance apply without meeting the deductible. Supply limits and mail-order options are specified.

summaries.title: Outpatient surgery
summaries.summary: Outpatient surgery facility and physician fees are not covered until the deductible is met, then 0% coinsurance applies. Preauthorization is required or the claim is denied. Out-of-network is not covered.

summaries.title: Emergency and urgent care
summaries.summary: Emergency room care and transportation cost 0% coinsurance after deductible. Urgent care has a $120 copay with no deductible. Virtual urgent care visits cost $75 or are free via CirrusMD.

summaries.title: Hospital stay
summaries.summary: Hospital stay facility and physician fees are covered at 0% coinsurance after deductible. Out-of-network services are not covered. Preauthorization may be required; failure may result in denial.

summaries.title: Mental health and substance use
summaries.summary: Outpatient mental health visits cost $85 copay (no deductible). Inpatient care is free after deductible. Out-of-network not covered. Preauthorization may be required.

summaries.title: Pregnancy
summaries.summary: Pregnancy office visits, childbirth professional and facility services are covered in-network at 0% coinsurance after deductible. Out-of-network services are not covered. Preventive services may have different cost sharing.

summaries.title: Recovery and special needs
summaries.summary: Rehabilitation and habilitation visits cost $120 each, no deductible. Home health, skilled nursing, DME, and hospice are free after the deductible, with annual visit/day limits and possible preauthorization requirements.

summaries.title: Children's eye and dental care
summaries.summary: Children's eye exams and glasses are covered in-network only, after deductible, with a limit of one per year. Dental check-ups are not covered.
highlights: Eye exam: one per year, under 19
Glasses: one pair per year, under 19

summaries.title: Services not covered
summaries.summary: Not covered: Abortion (except in the case of a medical emergency of a pregnant woman), Acupuncture, Bariatric surgery, Children's dental check-up, Cosmetic surgery (except as required for certain situations), Dental care (Adult), Infertility treatment, Long-term care…

content.headline: Moda Bronze vs. Anthem Catastrophic: premium, deductible, and cost trade-offs.
key_points: Anthem Catastrophic has the lowest annual premium at $3,480; Moda Bronze is highest at $3,840.
Moda Bronze has the lowest deductible ($8,700) and out-of-pocket limit ($8,700); Anthem Catastrophic is highest ($10,600 each).
In the no-care best case, Anthem Catastrophic costs $360 less than Moda Bronze; in the worst case, Moda Bronze costs $1,540 less.
Moda Bronze covers specialist visits with a $120 copay (deductible doesn't apply); Anthem Catastrophic covers them at 0% coinsurance after deductible.
Anthem Catastrophic covers children's dental check-ups; Moda Bronze does not cover them.

scenarios.text: For a checkup, a couple of sick visits and a few generic prescriptions, Anthem Catastrophic has the lowest total cost at $3,600, which is $510 less than Moda Bronze's $4,110.
For regular specialist care, some tests, an MRI and a monthly generic drug, Moda Bronze has the lowest total cost at $6,235, which is $45 less than Anthem Catastrophic's $6,280.
For a hospital stay, an ER visit, frequent specialist care and a monthly brand drug, Moda Bronze has the lowest total cost at $12,540, which is $1,540 less than Anthem Catastrophic's $14,080.

Moda Bronze's out-of-pocket limit equals its deductible ($8,700), so you pay full cost until the deductible is met.
For services where the deductible is not stated, costs are shown as a range and the actual amount depends on whether the deductible applies.
